concept: Updating your view when the evidence changes, without it feeling like 'losing'
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student takes a position on a low-stakes topic, then is shown new information that complicates it
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to adjust their position
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made adjusting the view feel easy or hard

assessment.success_marker: student can articulate why updating a view based on evidence is a strength, not a defeat
